Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules linked to document CHEMBL1134488. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id to identify the document, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (only include rows where canonical_smiles is present). Get compound_name from compound_records. Return rows ordered by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
